newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, demand seen to increase.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, demand seen to increase.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were little changed from late Thursday's quotes, traders said.

They said market talk was thin as shipowners were at standoff at current high prices. But sellers were expecting demand to increase later Friday as buyers might emerge to cover ahead of the long weekend.

Majors were quoting 180-cst at $125 per tonne and 380 cst at $120. Independents were lower at $118 for 380-cst and at $123 for 180-cst supplies. MDO and gas oil prices were at $215-$220 and $230-$235 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
